changelog.summary: Adds a health-to-renewal proposal with exact contract, notice, billing and owner-decision checks.

title: Renewal Risk to Owned Decision
description: Join bounded customer-health evidence to current SaaS contract and billing terms for an owner-reviewed renewal decision.
setup_prompt: Use Renewal Risk to Owned Decision as a chat-led proposal for one contracted SaaS account. Inspect existing Customer Health Coordinator and Renewal Coordinator Crews, exact account and legal entity, executed contract/revision, subscription, notice rule/timezone, billing and health sources, prior notice and renewal owner. Propose Crew reuse or reviewed creation, blocking artifact validators, one real manual case with an unknown or missing-terms control, owner review and a paused repeat choice. Selection does not contact a customer, change contract or CRM, grant a credit, cancel or claim renewal.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, customer account, legal entity and renewal owner
Executed agreement, revision, subscription, renewal and notice terms with timezone
Approved health window, source coverage and observed-versus-hypothesis rule
Current invoice/payment source and disputed or open-state interpretation
Owner decision, customer contact and contract-change authority
Manual-only or reviewed renewal-event and notification route

focus_areas: Contracts approaching notice with current owner decisions
